intro: MCP servers are small programs that give AI agents real capabilities — renting a GPU, reading a CAD assembly — through a standard interface. These are the lab's tools. Each page will take you from nothing installed to a working agent connection.

tools.name: runpod-mcp
tools.tagline: External GPU compute for the lab: rent, supervise, and auto-stop cloud GPUs from an agent.

tools.name: onshape-mcp
tools.tagline: CAD access for agents: read parts, assemblies, and metadata from Onshape documents.
